quarterly_data.signal: MasTec 10-Q: estimated 18-month backlog by segment at June 30, 2026 was Communications $5,461 million, Clean Energy and Infrastructure $7,791 million, Power Delivery $6,347 million and Pipeline Infrastructure $1,792 million ($21,391 million in total), about 40% expected to be realized in 2026 and 40% under master service or other service agreements; remaining performance obligations were $16.3 billion, about $6.6 billion (40.5%) expected as 2026 revenue.
